source_en: Officer. I saw what was left of Vlad this morning. I didn't stop.
After the blast, I chased my burning pages [[whisper:into the green]]. It was warm.
I cough blood every morning. Then I put on my cap and deliver.
Nobody. I told the soldiers I hid in the cellar. They stamped it.
Last night I woke up on my route, satchel on. I don't remember leaving.
At the pylons on the ridge. Listening to the wires hum.
Every morning there's a little less of me.
Don't report me yet, Officer. Let me finish the route.
